text:
maria_cs: Heads up — prepping QBR for Meridian next week. They spiked embeddings last month; need a consolidated token-econ snapshot + budget-alert runbook. Can @alex_finops and @sam_onboarding sync on numbers? I pulled a quick usage snapshot below.

maria_cs:
```
account: meridian
period: 2026-02
tokens_total: 2,345,671
embeddings_units: 1,120,334
avg_per_token_cost: $0.0006
notable: bulk-embed job started 2026-02-05
projected_delta (next 30d): +78%
```

alex_finops: On it — I'll generate conservative / expected / aggressive burn scenarios and put the numbers into the QBR deck. Also adding a 'credits cushion' recommendation (suggest +20% retainer) and a quick calculation of runway. Will share by EOD.

sam_onboarding: Quick check — did the client flip on the batch embed pipeline or was that a config change on our side? Kayla, any visibility from enablement calls?

kayla_csm: Confirmed we enabled 2 nodes for their bulk-embed on Feb 5 as part of the onboarding handshake. I can scale it down to 1 node for a rolling canary if we want to reduce burn immediately. Also drafting the enablement notes to send to their eng tomorrow.

alerts_bot: Budget Alert — meridian exceeded 80% of monthly retainer on 2026-02-18. Trigger: embeddings high throughput. Suggested immediate actions: 1) notify customer + CSM, 2) enable per-request rate limit for embeddings, 3) enable prefix KV cache for repeated inputs.

maria_cs: Perfect — Alex, please include the runbook steps in the deck: notify cadence, throttle thresholds, fallback to quantized model X-small, and the ask for a short credits bump. I'll collect their recent evals and customer impact examples for the QBR. Kayla/Sam, can you be on the call? :thumbsup:

kayla_csm: I'm on.

sam_onboarding: I can join too. I'll also capture the exact job configs so we can recommend a safer default.

maria_cs: Thanks team — let's aim to have the slide + runbook in the shared folder by tomorrow 11:00 PT. I'll ping once Alex's scenarios are uploaded.
